title: Foundational Models Defining a New Era in Vision: A Survey and Outlook
summary: Foundational models integrate multiple modalities to perform contextual reasoning and support prompt capabilities, enabling tasks like object segmentation, dialogue, and behavior control through language instructions.

title: No Free Checker: A Survey of Verifiers for Robot Policies
summary: A verifier for robot policies reads a candidate behavior and returns a score for how well it did, used both to evaluate vision-language-action policies and to train them. Verifiers range from success detectors and reward models to runtime monitors, safety filters, and temporal-logic specifications.
